plumbing.name: 2018 IRC Chapters 25-33 for houses; state-adopted IPC is 2021 (effective 2025-04-17) for other work

elsewhere: Local governments may adopt building codes but must use the State Fire Marshal's designated editions; some rural counties have none. Statewide minimum fire/life-safety and electrical (NEC) licensing apply.

elec.afciLocations.amendment: Tennessee makes AFCI optional for certain bathroom, laundry, garage, unfinished basement and refrigeration circuits; laundry areas dropped from the required list

notes: Checked 2026-10-17 against the SFMO currently-adopted-codes page: IRC 2018 and IECC 2018 (residential) from 2020-07-16, NEC 2017 from 2018-03-19 with optional 110.24 and AFCI relief, IPC 2021 from 2025-04-17. Large cities (Nashville) are on newer local editions.
